verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents batch inference for processing large volumes of requests asynchronously at a discount, which directly supports bulk operations across many items, and this is corroborated by dedicated docs pages. However, evidence is limited to inference batching; there's no documented bulk API for other operations (e.g., bulk model management, bulk fine-tuning jobs, bulk dataset uploads) or independent hands-on confirmation of batch-inference reliability at scale. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations beyond inference (e.g., bulk deployment/model management, bulk data uploads), independent/hands-on validation of batch-inference at scale, and API-level detail (schema/limits) for bulk requests.
